protocol: Bounded fixed-bound inner-QP prototype. Corrected exact-input reduced S/q. ADMM splitting z in original product of positive rays, fixed boxes/balls; contact radii frozen from either zero normal state or captured normal state. Scalar-per-block diagonal D=max eigenvalue local Sblock (same numerical scale as natural map), no relaxation/adaptive penalties. One Cholesky(S+D) per geometry shared between both arms; solve x=(S+D)^-1(D(z-u)-q), z=project(x+u), u+=x-z. Cold/capped primal seeds respective arms. At most1024iterations; require normalized fixed-bound natural residual<=1e-8, original-domain feasibility<=1e-8 and scaled splitting primal<=1e-8. Before iterations,24linear solves must agree with direct residual<=1e-10. Compare objective with independently solved same-bound Clarabel reference as diagnostic, not acceptance replacement. Stop outer/GPU expansion if either arm fails. Dense CPU numerical prototype only; no GPU speed/ownership claim. No retuning or larger budget.
